description: 按认证密钥查看代理流量、双链路 TCP 诊断与隧道明细，并下钻主机资源、磁盘和网络。主机面板不随设备筛选。

links.title: Node Exporter Full
links.tooltip: Node Exporter Full 1860 rev45 · 主机详情

panels.description: 显示最近一次抓取的结果。
panels.title: 采集状态

panels.description: c>p 为上传，c

targets.expr: sum by (access_key, dir, proto) (rate(shadowsocks_data_bytes{access_key=~"$device",dir=~"^(c>p|c<p)$",proto=~"^(tcp|udp)$"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(access_key, dir, proto) (sum by (access_key, dir, proto) (increase(shadowsocks_data_bytes{access_key=~"$device",dir=~"^(c>p|c<p)$",proto=~"^(tcp|udp)$"}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0)

panels.title: 设备上下行速率

panels.description: 按设备、方向和协议估算所选时段结束时的字节增量，仅显示正增量。c>p 为上传，c
panels.title: 所选时段的设备流量

panels.description: increase 估算所选时段的隧道计数器增量。原生计数器累加活动密钥／来源 IP 的持续时间，多来源会重复累计墙钟时间；不是物理设备开机时间。仅统计筛选后的非空认证密钥，仅显示同期有客户端流量或 TCP 下载字节的设备。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key) (increase(shadowsocks_tunnel_time_seconds{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) and on(access_key) ((sum by (access_key) (increase(shadowsocks_data_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!="",dir=~"^(c>p|c<p)$",proto=~"^(tcp|udp)$"}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0) or (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0))

panels.title: 所选时段隧道时长估算

panels.description: 按状态统计所选时段内已关闭的 TCP 连接，仅包含筛选后的非空认证密钥，仅显示同期有客户端流量或 TCP 下载字节的设备；不是在线连接数。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key, status) (increase(shadowsocks_tcp_connections_closed{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) and on(access_key) ((sum by (access_key) (increase(shadowsocks_data_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!="",dir=~"^(c>p|c<p)$",proto=~"^(tcp|udp)$"}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0) or (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0))

panels.title: 所选时段 TCP 关闭连接

panels.description: 当前打开 TCP 套接字的平均 RTT：秒数总和 ÷ 正样本数。source 为源站侧，device 为客户端侧；连接关闭或采样缺失时不补零。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key, leg) (keel_tcp_rtt_seconds_sum{access_key=~"$device",access_key!="",leg=~"^(source|device)$"}) / (sum by (access_key, leg) (keel_tcp_rtt_samples{access_key=~"$device",access_key!="",leg=~"^(source|device)$"}) > 0) and on(access_key) (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (max_over_time(keel_tcp_device_notsent_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_device_retrans_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0)

panels.title: 双链路实时 RTT

panels.description: source 为 VPS 从源站接收的 payload 字节速率；device 为已被客户端 ACK 的加密 TCP 字节速率。两者口径不同，便于比较传输进度与协议开销。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key, leg) (rate(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!="",leg=~"^(source|device)$"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(access_key) (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (max_over_time(keel_tcp_device_notsent_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_device_retrans_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0)

panels.title: 双链路下载速率

panels.description: VPS 在 device 链路发往客户端的加密 TCP 重传字节速率；不表示源站侧或客户端上行重传。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key) (rate(keel_tcp_device_retrans_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__rate_interval])) and on(access_key) (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (max_over_time(keel_tcp_device_notsent_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_device_retrans_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0)

panels.title: 设备链路重传字节速率

panels.description: 当前 device 链路中 VPS 发往客户端、尚未发送的加密 TCP 字节总和；用于观察发送积压，采样缺失不补零。

targets.expr: sum by (access_key) (keel_tcp_device_notsent_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}) and on(access_key) (sum by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_download_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (max_over_time(keel_tcp_device_notsent_bytes{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0 or max by (access_key) (increase(keel_tcp_device_retrans_bytes_total{access_key=~"$device",access_key!=""}[$__range] @ ${__to:date:seconds})) > 0)

panels.title: 设备链路未发送字节
